same_scene_when_traced.method: Esri Wayback metadata layers queried at the same point
same_scene_when_traced.note: Roofs were traced 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-23. The release live on those dates was Wayback 2026-08-05, which served the same block and the same capture date as today.

acquisition_time.note: Esri's metadata carries the date but not the time. WorldView-2 is sun-synchronous with a descending node near 10:30 local, so capture was probably mid-morning, but that is an expectation and not a record. For the FR-3 shadow check the time is recoverable from the imagery itself: a shadow's bearing gives the solar azimuth, which gives the hour angle for a known date and latitude. Bearing and length are independent measurements, so using the bearing to fix the time leaves the length free to test the elevation model.
